import json
from collections import Counter
p='answers.jsonl';r=[json.loads(s) for s in open(p)];c=[json.loads(s) for s in open('items.jsonl')]
for i in range(48,56):
 x=dict(card_id=c[i]['card_id'],letters='y',marks='y' if i in [48,50,51,53,54] else 'na',crop_ok='y',errors=[],detail='',owner_crop={k:'no' for k in ['one_central_line','text_ne_visible_line','other_complete_line','gt2_whole_neighbour_words','turned_or_clipped']},where=[])
 if i==51:
  x.update(crop_ok='n',errors=['crop_overrun'],segmentation_detail='Rotated text, with readable partial words from the adjacent line. No complete adjacent line and no more than two whole neighbour words.');x['owner_crop']['turned_or_clipped']='yes'
 if i==54:
  x.update(crop_ok='n',segmentation_detail='The complete line is turned approximately 90 degrees.');x['owner_crop']['turned_or_clipped']='yes'
 r.append(x)
for i in [11,36,42,47]:
 r[i]['errors']=[]
 r[i]['segmentation_detail']='The complete line is turned approximately 90 degrees.'
with open(p,'w') as f:
 for x in r:f.write(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(r)==len(c)
assert [x['card_id'] for x in r]==[x['card_id'] for x in c]
assert len(set(x['card_id'] for x in r))==len(r)
for x in r:
 assert all(k in x for k in ['card_id','letters','marks','crop_ok','errors','detail','owner_crop','where'])
 assert all(v in ['yes','no','uncertain'] for v in x['owner_crop'].values())
print('Count and order checked:',len(r))
for k in ['letters','marks','crop_ok']:print(k,dict(Counter(x[k] for x in r)))
print('Errors:',Counter(e for x in r for e in x['errors']).most_common())
